title: Guardrail contract
description: One file per guardrail in the envelope. A guardrail is a sequence of effective windows, contiguous and non-overlapping. A decision taken in April is judged by April's window, permanently, even after the rule changes again — so no window is ever edited or deleted, only closed and succeeded.

applies_to.description: The decision paths this guardrail constrains. `markdown` actuates itself; `base_price` is a proposal to a human.

safe_state.description: Doctrine rule 1 — the safe state is asymmetric and declared per decision path. No path inherits the other's answer.

effective_to.description: The first date on which this window is NO LONGER in force. Half-open: [effective_from, effective_to). null means still in force.

rule.description: Deliberately permissive about shape and absolute about provenance: `source` is required here, and an independent structural check refuses any `value` at any nesting depth that has no `source` beside it. The schema cannot be widened into a hole.

statement.description: What the rule forbids or requires, in one sentence, in the terms the decision path uses.
